Feature.appearance.dark-theme.Name: Dark theme for apps and Windows
Feature.appearance.dark-theme.Descriptio: Switches apps and the Windows shell to the dark color mode. Your wallpaper is not changed.
Makes windows, the taskbar and menus opaque instead of translucent.
Feature.explorer.show-file-extensions.De: Shows extensions such as .exe or .pdf for known file types, which makes disguised files easier to spot.
Feature.explorer.show-hidden-files.Name: Show hidden files and folders
Feature.explorer.show-hidden-files.Descr: Makes hidden items visible in File Explorer. Files protected by the operating system stay hidden.
Feature.explorer.open-to-this-pc.Name: Open File Explorer to This PC
Feature.explorer.open-to-this-pc.Descrip: Starts File Explorer on This PC instead of Home.
Feature.taskbar.align-left.Name: Align taskbar icons to the left
Feature.taskbar.align-left.Description: Moves the Start button and icons to the left edge, like Windows 10.
Feature.taskbar.hide-task-view.Name: Hide the Task view button
Feature.taskbar.hide-task-view.Descripti: Removes the Task view button from the taskbar. Win+Tab still works.
Feature.taskbar.hide-search-box.Name: Hide the taskbar search box
Feature.taskbar.hide-search-box.Descript: Removes the search box from the taskbar. Search stays available from the Start menu and with the Windows key.
Feature.taskbar.show-end-task.Name: Show “End task” in the taskbar right-click menu
Feature.taskbar.show-end-task.Descriptio: Adds End task to the context menu of taskbar apps, handy for closing a frozen program.
Feature.taskbar.hide-copilot-button.Name: Hide the Copilot button on the taskbar
Feature.taskbar.hide-copilot-button.Desc: Removes the Copilot button from the taskbar. Copilot itself is not uninstalled or turned off.
Feature.privacy.disable-advertising-id.D: Stops apps from using your advertising ID to personalize ads across apps.
Feature.privacy.disable-tailored-experie: Turn off tailored experiences from diagnostic data
Stops Windows from using diagnostic data to offer you tips, ads and recommendations.
Feature.privacy.disable-start-suggestion: Hide suggested apps in the Start menu
Stops the Start menu from showing suggested and promoted apps.
Feature.privacy.disable-start-tip-recomm: Turn off tip and shortcut recommendations in Start
Stops the Start menu from showing recommendations for tips, shortcuts and new apps.
Feature.privacy.disable-tips-notificatio: Turn off Windows tips and suggestion notifications
Stops notifications that suggest features or ways to get the most out of Windows.
Feature.privacy.disable-settings-suggest: Stops the Settings app from showing suggested content and promotions.
Feature.privacy.disable-lock-screen-tips: Hide tips and fun facts on the lock screen
Removes tips, tricks and fun facts from the lock screen.
Feature.privacy.opt-out-language-list.Na: Don't share my language list with websites
Feature.privacy.opt-out-language-list.De: Stops Windows from letting websites read your list of languages to tailor content.
Feature.privacy.disable-web-search-in-st: Turn off web results in Start search
Start search shows only local results and no longer sends your typing to Bing. Written as a user policy value, so Windows may show that some settings are managed by your organization.
Feature.input.disable-mouse-acceleration: Makes pointer movement proportional to hand movement, which many people prefer for games and precise work. Takes effect after you sign out and back in.
Feature.taskbar.never-combine-buttons.De: Shows every open window as its own labeled button, on every monitor. Needs Windows 11 22H2 or newer.
Feature.taskbar.show-seconds-in-clock.Na: Show seconds in the taskbar clock
Feature.taskbar.show-seconds-in-clock.De: Adds seconds to the clock in the system tray.
Feature.taskbar.hide-badges.Name: Hide badges on taskbar icons
Feature.taskbar.hide-badges.Description: Removes unread-count badges from the app icons on the taskbar.
Feature.taskbar.enable-show-desktop-corn: Show desktop from the taskbar corner
Clicking the far right edge of the taskbar shows the desktop.
Feature.explorer.show-full-path-in-title: Show the full path in the File Explorer title bar
Shows the whole folder path in the window title.
Feature.explorer.show-empty-drives.Name: Show empty drives
Feature.explorer.show-empty-drives.Descr: Shows drives with no media in them, such as empty card readers.
Feature.explorer.show-protected-os-files: Also shows files Windows hides to protect itself. Deleting or editing them can break Windows, so turn this on only if you need it.
Feature.explorer.hide-sync-provider-noti: Stops File Explorer from showing OneDrive and other sync-provider promotions and notifications.
Feature.explorer.disable-recent-and-freq: Turn off recent files and frequent folders in Quick access
File Explorer no longer lists recently used files or frequently used folders on Home.
Feature.explorer.show-selection-checkbox: Adds a checkbox to every item so you can select several with the mouse alone.
Feature.explorer.compact-view.Name: Use compact spacing in File Explorer
Feature.explorer.compact-view.Descriptio: Reduces the space between items in lists.
Feature.start.disable-recent-items-track: Turn off recently opened items in Start, Jump Lists and File Explorer
Windows stops tracking recently opened items for those places.
Feature.privacy.disable-app-launch-track: Stops Windows from tracking which apps you launch to improve Start and search results.
Feature.privacy.disable-silent-app-insta: Stop automatic installation of suggested apps
Stops Windows from silently installing promoted apps and pre-installing sponsored apps for your account. Apps that are already installed are not removed.
Feature.privacy.disable-feedback-prompts: Windows stops asking you for feedback.
Feature.privacy.disable-finish-setup-sug: Turn off “finish setting up your device” suggestions
Hides the welcome experience and the prompts that suggest ways to get the most out of Windows.
Feature.search.hide-search-highlights.De: Removes the daily illustrations and trending topics from the search box and the search pane.
Feature.search.disable-cloud-content-sea: Search stops looking through your Microsoft account and work or school account content online.
Feature.search.disable-device-search-his: Turn off search history on this device
Windows stops saving what you search for on this device.
Feature.multitasking.disable-snap-assist: After you snap a window, Windows no longer suggests other windows to fill the rest of the screen.
Feature.multitasking.disable-snap-layout: Turn off snap layouts on hover
Hovering over the maximize button no longer opens the snap layout picker.
Feature.multitasking.disable-window-snap: Dragging a window to a screen edge no longer resizes it automatically.
Feature.multitasking.alt-tab-hide-browse: Alt+Tab shows only windows, not individual Edge tabs.
Feature.appearance.disable-animations.Na: Turn off window and taskbar animations
Feature.appearance.disable-animations.De: Windows minimize and restore without animation, and the taskbar skips its animations.
Feature.appearance.accent-on-start-and-t: Show the accent color on Start and the taskbar
Colors Start and the taskbar with your accent color (visible in dark mode).
Feature.gaming.disable-game-bar-shortcut: Turn off the Game Bar controller button and startup tips
Stops the controller button from opening the Xbox Game Bar and hides its startup tips.
Feature.gaming.disable-game-capture.Name: Turn off game capture
Feature.gaming.disable-game-capture.Desc: Turns off game capture (recording and screenshots) for your account.
Feature.input.disable-sticky-keys-shortc: Turn off the Sticky Keys shortcut
Pressing Shift five times no longer opens the Sticky Keys prompt. This writes the standard flag value, so any custom Sticky Keys flags are replaced.
Feature.ai.disable-windows-copilot-polic: Writes the older Windows Copilot policy for your account. The newer Copilot app may ignore it. Windows may show that this setting is managed by your organization.
Feature.ai.disable-recall-snapshots-user: Turn off Windows Recall snapshots (user policy)
Stops Windows from saving Recall snapshots for your account. Only has an effect on PCs that offer Recall. Windows may show that this setting is managed by your organization.

AppDesc.app.clipchamp: Video editor that Microsoft installs for everyone.
AppDesc.app.bing-news: News feed app. The Start menu feed does not need it.
AppDesc.app.bing-weather: Weather app. The taskbar weather uses a different component.
AppDesc.app.bing-search: Bing helper for search suggestions in the Start menu.
AppDesc.app.solitaire: Card games with ads and an optional subscription.
AppDesc.app.get-help: Opens Microsoft support chat and troubleshooters.
AppDesc.app.tips: Shows welcome tips and what's new.
AppDesc.app.feedback-hub: Sends feedback and bug reports to Microsoft.
AppDesc.app.office-hub: Shortcut hub that advertises Microsoft 365. Does not remove Office itself.
AppDesc.app.people: Contacts app. Mail and Calendar can use it.
AppDesc.app.power-automate: Desktop automation tool, only useful if you build flows.
AppDesc.app.mixed-reality: Portal for Windows Mixed Reality headsets.
AppDesc.app.skype: Old Skype app. Skype is discontinued.
AppDesc.app.cortana: The old Cortana assistant, no longer developed.
AppDesc.app.teams-personal: Chat app for personal accounts, pinned by Windows 11.
AppDesc.app.teams: New Microsoft Teams. Remove only if you do not use Teams for work or school.
AppDesc.app.family: Family safety and parental controls app.
AppDesc.app.quick-assist: Lets someone help you remotely. Remove only if you never use remote help.
AppDesc.app.dev-home: Developer dashboard that most people never open.
AppDesc.app.copilot: The Copilot app. The taskbar button is a separate setting.
AppDesc.app.journal: Handwriting notes app for pen devices.
AppDesc.app.todo: Task list app that syncs with your Microsoft account.
AppDesc.app.phone-link: Connects your phone to the PC. Remove if you do not use it.
AppDesc.app.cross-device: Component behind Phone Link features. Remove together with Phone Link.
AppDesc.app.media-player: Default music and video player. Remove only if you use another player.
AppDesc.app.mail-calendar: Old Mail and Calendar apps (retired in favor of the new Outlook).
AppDesc.app.outlook-new: The new Outlook mail client. Remove only if you use another mail program.
AppDesc.app.sticky-notes: Sticky Notes. Your notes sync with your account; they are deleted from this PC with the app.
AppDesc.app.alarms: Clock app with alarms, timer and stopwatch.
AppDesc.app.xbox: Xbox app for games and Game Pass. Other Xbox components are separate (and Unsafe).
AppDesc.app.camera: Camera app. Webcams in other apps keep working.
AppDesc.app.paint: Paint. Many people use it for quick image edits.
AppDesc.app.photos: Default image viewer. Remove only if you have another viewer.
AppDesc.app.calculator: Calculator. Removing it leaves you without one until you reinstall it.
AppDesc.app.snipping-tool: Screenshot tool (Win+Shift+S). Removing it can disable that shortcut.
AppDesc.app.terminal: Windows Terminal. Remove only if you use another terminal.
AppDesc.app.store: Microsoft Store. Without it you cannot install or update Store apps, and some apps need it.
AppDesc.app.store-purchase: Store purchase dialogs. Needed for paid apps and in-app purchases.
AppDesc.app.xbox-identity: Xbox sign-in. Needed by Xbox, Minecraft and many Store games.
AppDesc.app.xbox-tcui: Xbox dialogs used by games. Removing it can break game sign-in.
AppDesc.app.xbox-game-overlay: Game overlay component used with Game Bar.
AppDesc.app.xbox-gaming-overlay: Game Bar (Win+G). Removing it can break game capture and overlays.
AppDesc.app.xbox-speech: Speech-to-text overlay used by Game Bar.
